user.title: Calendar climate schedule
user.description: Sets a mode and a temperature on climate entities while an event of a calendar is running, and another one when it ends. With a preheat gradient, the event settings are applied early enough for the room to be warm when the event starts.

data_description.calendar_entity_id: All the events of this calendar are followed.
data_description.climate_entity_ids: They all get the same mode and temperature. The coldest one decides when the preheat starts.
data_description.end_hvac_mode: 'Previous state' restores the mode and the temperature each entity had before the event.
data_description.preheat_gradient: Temperature gained by the room per hour of heating. Example: at 3°/h, a room at 15° is heated 2 hours before an event at 21°. Set to 0 to disable the preheat.
data_description.max_preheat: The preheat never starts earlier than this before an event.

error.temperature_required: A temperature is required for this mode.
